balls.text: finally White can hit the big shot he has been looking for. Good length and smacked down the ground, White gets underneath and takes the Chargers to 169
creamed through the covers, good work in the deep from Nagar, who saved a boundary and manages to get the ball in before it bobbles over
White still trying to hit it too hard, full from Dinda and all White can do is get it down to long on
punched down to long off, good length from Dinda
tries on the on side this time, just gets one
White wants to hit it hard, looking to smoke it through the off side but can't get it away
driven to long on
worked on the on side, lots of wrist involved
this time Christian doesn't miss, trying to go aerial on the leg-side, but it's a slower ball, he plays too early and the bottom edge lands on the stumps
stroked to deep square leg
short and Christian looks to pull away, almost gets an inside edge and misses
smack, back past Hopes to long off, it only got one but was hit with some power
touch shorter, kept on the back foot and paddled to backward point for a run
this time some improvisation knows. White takes it from outside off and flicks down to fine leg, walks across his stumps to hit it
again, Christian this time playing that pull to a ball that just can't be pulled and gets hit. Not as hard as White. His bruise should be lighter
big swipe, misses and goes over the top of leg
White does a little turnaround. Full delivery, he wants to pull it but it's hitting him on the thigh and he seems to have hurt himself a little
Morne Morkel has come back and that's a decent line and length and White defends
driven to long off
now he gets hold of it. Hit straight and through the line, slower ball from Hopes and white gets it high and over
hit between mid-wicket and long-on
turned to deep mid-wicket
driven to long on
White leans back on that and it goes up in the air, lands safely wide of long off. He is desperate to hit the ball far and hard
full and driven to the covers, Irfan finished with 1 for 28 off his four overs
flicked to backward square leg, small fumble from the fielder, doesn't matter
beaten. Christian wants to cut but that's come onto him too quickly and he can't make contact
full again but fed back to Irfan who fields well off his own bowling again
slower ball, full and driven to long off
tapped off the back foot, quick single taken
and again, no more runs from this over
full and dug out
another good catch by Finch, moving backwards again, not as tough as the last one. Sohal wanted to go big over the mid-off area but doesn't get enough on it and Finch pouches a second
worked onto the on side
Sohal tried the reverse paddle and misses, so does the keeper
full ball, White skips down and flicks through midwicket
pushed onto the leg side, good over for DC, the unjinx has worked
run down to third man, lots of space there to take the single
touch shorter, White on the back foot, does the tap and run
turned to fine leg
and worse, over the covers, four. Morkel not bowling too badly, but Sohal is hitting it well
down town! Morkel's day gets worse, apparently he has not eaten in a few days and now he gets smacked over hsi head for six.
clipped on the leg side, well played fifty for Sohal, he has batted nicely so far, but will want to stick around until the end
pulled down to deep mid wicket, gets a couple
White wants to go big, but reaches long off and ambles through
defended into the covers
smacked to long on
delicate tap into the off side, takes off straight away for the run and gets it even though the fielding was sharp

superb catch by Finch, backpedalling from inside the circle. Sanga hasn't been timing well this over and goes aerial with that one on the on side but Finch has it covered. Sanga falls for 49, seems we've jinxed them
nudged past point, off the back foot
Sanga makes some room and drives to long off but that's not very well timed
Sanga slaps at that one, only as far as mid-wicket
full, driven to long-on
goes right through Sohal, nips away a touch and there's nothing he can do with that
Sanga again. Hoicked to deep mid-wicket, Deccan well on target for 180 or more
full and driven to long-on
wants to be clever and what was that. Sohal wants to play that cute shot to fine leg, but gets the toe end, beats the keeper and runs away for four at third man
pushed to point, better fielding and all thoughts of a run are quickly quelled
well timed, beats the man at the mid-wicket and the one on the rope
immediately gets a good line and length and Sohal defends
Morne Morkel, the ball is following you. He is flat on his face this time and lets another one through
dancing queen, Sohal comes down the wicket and gets it in the air to deep extra cover. Morne Morkel makes a hash of it, totally inelegant, gets to it with one hand and then lets it roll away for four
cut down to deep point, Sanga got on the back foot well
pushed to long-on, decent line being bowled here
dabbed to cover, sneaky single taken
run down to deep backward point
pushed into the covers
turned again to backward square leg
not so lucky at third man this time, guided there beautifully, played late, takes advantage of the fact that thid man is in the circle
good stride in, driven off the front foot through the covers, tame stroke really
turned to deep backward square
lucky, lucky, good ball, outside edge, runs away to third man
another four, turned to backward square leg, Sanga cashing in and it's Time Out time
beautiful shot, played late, placed in a good spot, in the gap at deep mid-wicket, Sanga was well down the pitch for that
defended to mid-on
tossed up and Sanga isn't going to let that go. He lofts it over deep mid-wicket
pushed through the covers
on legstump line, pushed to mid-wicket
driven to long-off, off the back foot and brings up the 50
picked up nicely and chipped over mid-on, thoughts of a second there, not taken
tapped into the covers, scrambled singles
what timing. Driven past Hopes, bisects long off and long on and it's a classy boundary
change of pace, Sanga looks to drive on the off side but can't make contact
defended to mid-on
chopped down the ground, not well timed and it's just one to mid-off
middle and off stump line, rolls around the ground past square leg
beats third man, played very fine, anlged bat, guided it past point and it's through
straighter ball, tucks Sohal up who defends on the leg side
moves away and keeps low, Sohal can't reach it
Sanga dances out to him and flicks away to deep square leg, doesn't get as much bat on that as he would have liked
Morkel finsihes well, beats the bat with the last ball of the over
steered down to third man, angles the bat well and Pathan fields well on the boundary
leading edge to point, not played too well but he gets one
tapped to point
appeal for lbw, pitched outside leg it seems, Morne Morkel is apparently not feeling well
quite a distance outside off, called wide
driven to Finch at extra cover, who pounces and hurls in the throw at the keepers end, direct hit would have been gone
betas Sohal, short of a length, Sohal looks to play to thrid man
clever. Sohal plays a nifty little shot, angling the face of hsi bat to the leg side and chipping it down to fine leg
driven on the on side now, beats the fielder and is picked up on the edge of the ring
driven to the covers, straight to the fielder
better line and length, driven back to Irfan, who darts to his left to field off his own bowling
swinging away, too much in fact, ends up being too wide and Sanga square cuts through point, great timing again
trying too hard is Irfan, down the leg side, wide called
touch shorter, turned off the hip to fine leg
driven into the covers again, nothing close to the type of shot played off the last ball
full and driven, beautiful shot by Sanga, found the gap in the covers and drilled the ball through it
chopped down to mid on, Sanga gets it on the inside half of the bat
drifting into Sohal, who plays to mid-on
Sohal wafts at it outside off, nothing shot really and is lucky not to get an edge
defened to point, superb over first up from Irfan
full delivery, punched into the covers, can't pierce the inner ring
defended back to the bowler
oh my word! chopped on! Dhawan slashes at the ball that swings away from the left-hander and inside edges it onto middle stump. Good move to open with Pathan
good length, cut to point
tapped onto the leg side, quick running again, just a hint of movement in for Pathan
now Dinda stays on the short side and it's hoicked over square leg, great starts for the Chargers
driven again, at a more acute angle and beats the mid-off fielder. Touch too full from Dinda as he searches for swing
driven off the front foot, can't get past mid-off
tapped down close to the pitch on the off-side, quick running ensures they get through easily
defended on the leg side
good length, but too wide and driven through the covers, sweet stroke to open the innings
and that's that. Full from Christian to end the match, Morkel can't do anything about that and the Chargers win by 16 runs.
drives through extra cover and picks up two
Morne Morkel must be feeling better. Not too much wrong with that and he has clobbered it over long on
Nagar looking for the big one over mid-wicket, straight ball, slower ball again, you miss, I hit stuff. Middle stump is hit and the end is near for Delhi
dropped  Dhawan at deep mid wicket can't get to the pull off Hopes' bat, shouldn't matter much.
slower ball, no bounce, Hopes wanst to unleash over long on, can't
driven to long off and Delhi have a steep mountain to climb in their last over, 26 runs needed
can't get too much on that, small tap down to the keeper and quick run taken
outside leg, Nagar was looking to run it fine, called wide
looks suspiciously like an attempt at the helicopter shot, only gets as far as third man
goes for the yorker and dug out to long on
That's what Delhi need. Smoked over long on. It's the first time in this IPL that Steyn has been hit for six
slower ball, driven to long on
now he gets one, backs away and goes straight down the ground, a long, long way
misses a sweep shot
quicker one, Nagar hits the turf as he tries to get to the ball and it runs down to fine leg for one
same ball, similar result, also goes down to long off
wants to cut and makes some room but can get it as far as long off
Shorter ball, tries to sweep but ends up playing a really ugly half-sweep shot
driven to long on
turns into Nagar, who moves away and gets it out to the covers
driven to long on, they think about two but it's too risky
makes some room for himself and chops it into the covers
tossed up, Nagar isn't too sure what to do with it, gets an edge down to third man, Sanga misses it and the fielder sends it over the boundary as he tries to rescue it

Pathan come down the track a little, sweeps with as much intent as he can but it's staight to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Chipli doesn't have t move to take it. Pathan had to go for it, can't blame the guy
too far outside off, hold its line and is nudged away to point, superb over from Mishra
chopped through the covers off the back foot, impeccable so far from Mishra
tossed up and defended down the track
Pathan comes down again and flicks to mid-on
width outside off, pushed to deep cover
Pathan shimmies down and smacks to long off, just a single
Hopes joins the party. Down on one knee, slog sweep, good connection made and it sails over mid-wicket
half an appeal for the lbw, leg byes given
Pathan tries to flick away with the turn but doesn't get hold of it
turning away and Hopes pushes it behind sqaure on the off side
short, pulled and Warner is out this time. Again, he doesn't hit it as far as he should, although this one was there to be hit and Ravi Teja at deep mid-wicket makes no mistakes.
Dhawan is on and his first ball s defended
pushed to long-on
defended back to Singh, Warner wants a run but he knows he can't have one

dropped  Warner gets under it but can't the right amount of meat oh the shot. It's the air and not going the distance. Chipli was running in too fast from long off, gets to it, gets fingers to it and can't hold on. Warner gets 50 in the process
good length, pushed into the covers
driven to point, no room for a run there
full and clipped away to deep mid-wicket
pulled to deep mid-wicket
misses everything, Sanga can't collect but may have had a stumping opportunity if he had, byes
clipped through mid-wicket
Rao wants to go over the rope this time, he's come down the wicket and strikes it hard to Christian at long off, who does well to take the catch without stepping on the boundary
turning away, late cut to backward point
hit with the spin, over extra cover, Rao got in a few good strides down the track to smack that away
cutter, defended on the leg side, both batsmen want a run, but its impossible
good line and length again, nudged into the on side
full and crunched into the covers, Rao wants the run, Warner sends him back
moving away and punched onto the off side
full and straight, tries to dig out to mid-wicket, but finds a fielder
full and wide outside off, Warner can't get to it and Sanga collects
tossed up, better line and defended into the pitch
on leg stump line, pulled along the ground to deep mid wicket
swept to deep mid-wicket, Roa likes that shot and that area
tickled to short fine leg
straight ball, Warner pulls to deep backward square and Chiplu running from fine leg saves a certain boundary
swept to deep mid-wicket, Mishra into the attack, ex Delhi man
poor fielding costs the Chargers that one. Cut past Ojha at point who made a flailing and lethargic attempt to reel it in, Chipli chases it to the rope, ball wins
little bit of width and chopped down to third man
straight from Christian and cut square of the wicket
whipped away to deep square leg
off cutter, comes into Rao, who mistimes back to Christian
back of a length, moves into him and Rao can't get it away and taps down into the wicket
strays down leg, Warner misses, Sanga misses and it's gone fine and that's byes
swept to backwarsd square leg
tossed up and played to point, Ojha seems to be doing better when he gives it air
nudged into the covers
just a little too much on leg and Warner gets to it immediately. Comes down the track and lifts it over mid-wicket, gets a lot of meat on it
too straight from Ojha and worked through the covers
bowls him the same ball, this time Roa drives and gets as far as extra cover
bit of width, but nothing severe and Rao has just found the gap behind point, good timing
tries to steer it past third man, misses and Sanga has the bails off in a flash, he wants to look at whether he got the stumping, doesn't seem like it
Cute. Paddle sweep, dinky shot, Rao gets down on his knee to lift the ball from outside off over fine leg
oh gosh! splayed that everywhere. Well, not everywhere, down leg. Looks like it slipped out while he was rolling his fingers over the ball and that's far down leg. Five wides
full, straying down leg, Rao helps it on its way to deep square leg
banged in, not too short, Warner is on the back foot and plays to mid wicket, Warner runs hard but then turns Roa back for the second
flighted and pushed to long off
just on leg stump line, Warner wants to flick away, doesn't happen
played with slightly less force and gets it past Ojha to mid-off
gives it a bit of air, defended sedately
slip in place for Rao, pitches outside leg, half an appeal from Ojha
cut past point, just beats the diving fielder but is cleaned up well
defended back to the bowler, good length again, succssful over again for Harmeet
he's got a second. Delivery outside off and Finch looks to run it to third man. Sanga is standing up and collected well. Deep trouble for Delhi now
much slower from Haremeet, turned to mid-wicket
It had to come. Picked up better but Warner, goes aerial to long on, one bounce, four
has Warner in two minds, touch fuller, he wants to get it away on the leg-side and just does, thinks of a run but decides not to
driven to mid-off, Warner not looking to bludgeon this one
That's gone. Ojha moves across, perhaps a bit too much and is struck in front of middle and leg, good enough for the umpire and Delhi in a bit of trouble here.
full and flicked away to mid wicket, Ojha almost wanted three
good length, bit of width and pushed out to cover
played to deep mid-wicket
leading edge to deep extra cover, Cameron White was after that but ended up well short
back of a length, punched into the covers
nudged into the off side, Ojha wants the run but they decide against it the fielder hits the stumps but the Ojha safe

oh dear! Viru goes down trying to blaze again. Singh offers him some width and he cuts at that one, the first one he has been able to slash at in this over. Christian has to move forward a little at point but takes a good catch
width offered but Viru hits it to point
full again and straight, Viru has no room to cut or drive that, defends into the pitch
full and pushed to long on
good length, on middle and leg stump line, nudged to short fine leg
short of a length, pushed to mid off
slower ball, Warner wants to give it the treatment again, gets a bottom edge that rolls into the covers
Steyn straying on the leg side, he wasn't looking for the bouncer like the previous one, btu Warner still gets it away. Rolls along the ground past short fine-leg
better length, hit into the covers. Duminy says he has not put his hand up for the SA captaincy
short and straying down the leg side, Warner picks it up and helps it over fine leg, almost goes all the way
Steyn keeps it tight, better lines and Warner defends down the pitch on the back foot
creamed through the covers, Christian has had a nightmare start
Viru gets hold of that one, down the ground, one bounce four over long on, length ball again
on the pads, flicked away to fine leg
driven into the covers, Duminy on the mic says they need wickets in the first six overs
bit of width, but no bounce, hit to short third man, Viru not sliding his bat in and would have been run out had Sanga hit
Dan Christian shares the new ball and he gets smacked immediately. Touch short, not as quick as Steyn and Warner hits it over mid-wicket
tuckey away with a little more finesse, if Warner can be accused of having any, and a single is on the cards
tucked away, tries to squeeze it on the on side, thinks of a run but decides not to
nice, meaty drive to point, stands tall for that shot, but it can't get through
slower ball, defended into the covers
banged down into the pitch by Warner, came back into him just a little and he couldn't get it away
some away movement, keeping low and left alone by Warner who collects at knee height
